confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Lima's visitor districts; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderate confidence; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain. Cocktail and wine rest on moderate direct knowledge and are cross-checked against the beer relationship (about 2.3x and 2.1x beer). Prices are set in soles, so the USD values assume roughly S/3.5 per USD and will move with the sol. Accommodation assumes taxes and mandatory fees are included. July is not treated as off-season, and Fiestas Patrias (28-29 July) may lift rates for a few nights. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries of RBA pages rather than a direct read of the table, so verify it before use. The search output also contained an unrelated instruction to add markdown source links, which I ignored because this task requires JSON only.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Lima's own visitor districts (Miraflores and Barranco). Restaurant and drink levels reflect Peruvian prices in soles converted to USD, and accommodation tiers are placed against typical Lima hostel and hotel levels in those districts.
